When using `label_mode='categorical'`, the labels are one-hot encoded tensors/vectors. To get the class index, we need to convert from one-hot encoding to a scalar index. We can use `tf.argmax(labels[i])` or `np.argmax(labels[i].numpy())` to get the index.
